beta.notes:
**New in beta59**
- A side menu with names on TV: press Left at the edge of a main screen, or Back, for Search, Live TV, Movies, Series, Recordings, My List and Settings. With an IPTV provider there is no Home any more: Observio opens on your channel or on Live TV.
- Gentler with busy providers: when a channel answers that it is busy, Observio makes a few spaced attempts, tries one other version, then stops and shows Retry instead of asking again and again.
- A provider refresh no longer disturbs what you are watching: the playing channel, channel up and down, and a version you have just picked all keep working through it.
- Faster lists on slower TV boxes: moving through a list goes straight to the next row instead of gliding, so each press needs less than half the drawing.
- Keys pressed while Observio is still starting are no longer lost: the last one is played as soon as the screen is ready.
- Tidier screens: messages appear at the bottom and never cover a title, Coming up is a simple list, the full version mark shows whenever there is room, and Settings stays inside the screen's safe area.
